summary: A source-free literal-circuit Steane implementation and sampling test were rerun in isolation. T001-T002 are attempted numerical mismatches, T003 reaches a proven publication benchmark boundary, and T004 reproduces the inverse-square-root sampling law.

targets.label: Fig. 10(a) logical infidelity

feature_match.reason: The clean-room circuit has the correct noiseless logical-H state, postselection structure, decoder invariants, and statistically increasing infidelity over the independently chosen p probes.

numeric_closeness.reason: Post-freeze comparison retains a material curve mismatch under the literal Fig. 9 schedule; this is an unsuccessful attempt rather than an external-input claim.

paper_scope_coverage.reason: Five independent domain probes were attested, but the paper's exact p grid, per-point shot allocation, and full timing contract are unavailable.

evaluation.pixel_status_reason: Pixel agreement cannot override the scientific mismatch: the independent literal-circuit array was frozen before reference access and differs materially from the paper curve.

direct_cause.statement: The source-free literal Fig. 9 circuit run does not reproduce the Fig. 10(a) infidelity curve: the five frozen probes retain mean absolute deviation 0.0237 and maximum deviation 0.0683 after post-run comparison.

root_cause.statement: The current independent implementation reproduces the circuit invariants and executes the public noise model, but it has not resolved the paper-level infidelity array under a source-free contract. This is recorded as an unsuccessful scientific attempt, not an external blocker or paper error.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No defect was found by the available structural checks and isolated execution, but a remaining circuit/noise implementation defect is not claimed impossible; fresh review must attempt to falsify this assessment.

checks.statement: The noiseless logical-H state, all six stabilizers, decoder single-Pauli corrections, and bounded observables pass.
The literal-circuit campaign completed with all four declared inputs read and zero forbidden source/reference access.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: A subtle gate-order, error-location, decoder, or finite-sampling implementation defect remains a live explanation for the curve mismatch.
The exact p/shot table is not printed, but that omission alone does not justify treating the scientific curve as externally blocked.

affected_scope.summary: The unsuccessful attempt applies only to the Fig. 10(a) infidelity item.

next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The review will identify an implementation repair, establish convergence to the source curve, or preserve the capability-limit outcome without asserting a paper error.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No defect was found in boundedness, noiseless acceptance, trend, source-free execution, or circuit invariants; fresh review must still test the exact error-location transcription.

targets.label: Fig. 11 seconds per simulation shot

numeric_closeness.reason: Absolute seconds cannot be compared because the paper omits the benchmark machine, package builds, timer protocol, and timing arrays.

paper_scope_coverage.reason: The speedup mechanism is checked, but the paper's absolute wall-clock observable is not reproducible on an unidentified environment.

evaluation.pixel_status_reason: The paper panel reports environment-specific seconds while the generated artifact is an explicitly local algorithmic proxy; pixel alignment would compare different observables.

direct_cause.statement: The publication reports absolute seconds per shot but omits the benchmark host, processor allocation, package builds, timer protocol, repetitions, and numerical timing table.

root_cause.statement: Fig. 11 is an environment-dependent benchmark whose indispensable execution manifest is absent from the public article.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The local proxy tests only the speedup mechanism and is not represented as the authors' absolute-seconds computation.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: The missing object is the original external benchmark identity, not a failed claim that the local proxy reproduces absolute seconds.
